ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.subhead: Bringing the Taste of Home to the Netherlands
ourStory.p1: For more than 25 years, founder Thayapalan has shared the authentic flavours of Tamil home cooking with communities across Rotterdam and the Netherlands.
ourStory.p2: Tamil Food Thaya began with a simple idea: food should taste like home. Inspired by traditional Tamil cooking and the comforting meals made by mothers for generations, Thayapalan set out to preserve those flavours and share them with others.
ourStory.p3: From intimate family gatherings to weddings and large celebrations, every meal is prepared with the same values we started with — tradition, freshness, generosity and care.
ourStory.tagline: Tamil Food Thaya — traditional Tamil food, made with the warmth of home.
ourStory.founderAlt: Thayapalan, founder of Tamil Food Thaya
